basic_info.description: Why settle for a condo when you can have your own private yard, garage, and ample storage? Thoughtfully redesigned in 2023, this 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence is move-in ready. Tucked away in the residential Oceanview neighborhood, this beautifully updated single-family home offers the perfect blend of style, space, and comfort.  2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom on each level. Modern finishes blended with gorgeous old-world charm. Enjoy sleek new flooring, a brand-new roof, and a stylish kitchen outfitted with stone counters, custom cabintery, stainless steel appliances, completed in 2023. Natural light fills every room, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Step outside to a generous backyard, spacious deck, and 3 levels of yard space ideal for entertaining or relaxing in your own urban oasis. Street-level is a one-car garage plus tons of room for storage.    Location is everythingyou're minutes from Balboa BART or Daly City Bart, H Mart, SFSU, City College of San Francisco, Chinese American International School, and a variety of shops and eateries at Stonestown Galleria. With easy access to Alemany Blvd, 19th Ave, and freeways 101/280, commuting is a breeze. This home offers the lifestyle and convenience you've been looking forwelcome to your Oceanview retreat.
